text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a rainy day, Daiichi Ruby slightly lost 
her balance in a wet hallway.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...There is no problem. Thank you for your 
concern. Now, if you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because she had shown an 
ungraceful side of herself in public, 
Daiichi Ruby seemed somewhat downcast 
afterward.
